description: Launch a saved workspace by name. Legacy name kept for older clients — new integrations should call launch_workspace, which adds a 'screen' option to pull the whole workspace onto one monitor. Opens every app that is not running, waits for its windows, and moves them into the saved positions; macOS cannot open an app straight into a position, so windows appear first and jump into place. Returns per-app success and reports apps that never opened a window. Takes up to a minute for a large workspace.
name: apply_saved_layout
